landing.heroEyebrow: A memory for your working life
landing.heroDescription: Tell Tallyvane what you have done. It keeps the context, connects the details, and helps you turn your experience into the next move.

landing.memoryMapLabel: A project connects skills and outcomes to a role requirement
landing.roleMatchText: Turn user insight into product direction

landing.previewCaption: Your experience stays connected as your career moves forward.
landing.workflowTitle: Tell it once. Keep using what you know.
landing.workflowDescription: Your knowledge grows over time. Each opportunity gives it new context and a reason to act.
landing.rememberDescription: Capture projects, decisions, skills, answers, and outcomes in your own words.
landing.connectDescription: See how your evidence relates to a role you saved, including strengths and gaps.
landing.actDescription: Get one explained action, informed by your opportunities, compensation, and progress.
landing.faqTitle: A career memory that keeps its context.
landing.faqWhatAnswer: A connected record of your work, skills, decisions, and outcomes. It helps you understand roles, shape documents from your real experience, and decide what deserves attention next.
landing.faqSpreadsheetTitle: How does my experience help with an application?
landing.faqSpreadsheetAnswer: Your captured examples can be matched to a role's requirements and used to shape a résumé around the work you have actually done, so you do not have to reconstruct your story for every application.
landing.faqNotDoTitle: Does it invent résumé content for me?
landing.faqNotDoAnswer: Your experience is the source. Tallyvane helps you organize and apply the details you provide; you can review the result and keep it grounded in your own work and answers.
landing.faqWhoForTitle: Can I use it beyond one job search?
landing.faqWhoForAnswer: Yes. The knowledge you build about your experience is meant to stay useful as you explore new roles and make career decisions over time.
landing.closingTitle: Keep what you know. Carry it forward.
landing.closingDescription: Build a career memory that can support the next application, decision, and opportunity.
